about: Higgsfield brief for the Old HSK 1 game questions (core/packs/hsk1.js), same recipe and style as yct1-pictures.json. Originals -> assets-library/higgsfield/2026-10-12/hsk1/<world>/<slug>.png; web copy -> public/assets/packs/hsk1/<world>/<slug>.webp. Words already pictured for YCT 1 are copied, not regenerated (see reuse). Numbers 1-10 are composited by video_tools/count_pictures.py.
